purpose: Unify existing graph-operation contracts into a discoverable constructible-operation pool and resolve declarative graph plans before any executor is invoked.

pool.selection: query returns all compatible or deferred candidates; no ranking or recommendation
pool.live_registry_instance_inventory: deferred; this v1 does not enumerate initialized LayerRegistry identities

declarative_plan.dependency_policy: steps may reference declared inputs or outputs from earlier steps only

resolution_status.RESOLVED: one exact operation identity is selected for every step and all modeled static contracts are satisfied
resolution_status.AMBIGUOUS: more than one operation candidate remains or required caller/agent information is missing
resolution_status.DEFERRED: operation identity is known but one or more authoritative conditions cannot be proven until canonical constructor, registry, or Burn/runtime preflight
resolution_status.REJECTED: a known contract violation makes the declarative plan inadmissible

proof_matrix: known operation with unmodeled authoritative static rule -> DEFERRED
canonical layout subset compatibility is preserved from agent-layout-contracts.v1
resolved plan remains execution_authorized=false and mutation=none

invariants: the registry is derived from existing machine-readable contracts rather than becoming a new numerical source of truth
pool queries never rank or select an operation on behalf of the agent
RESOLVED does not authorize execution and does not bypass AgentLayerSpec constructor validation, LayerRegistry binding, graph preflight, or Burn
unknown or dynamic layout and shape semantics become DEFERRED rather than REJECTED unless an existing contract proves incompatibility
semantic output roles remain caller or agent declarations and are never inferred from numerical layer type
known layout, axis, arity, dependency, parameter-type, and graph-capacity mismatches fail before execution
the v1 pool enumerates constructible operation types, not live initialized LayerRegistry instances
future_extensions: live LayerRegistry instance inventory and identity-aware pool filtering
